title: Law to boost weekend cleanup in nightlife areas
summary: This bill would require the Department of Sanitation to designate certain busy nightlife areas, based on foot traffic, bar and club density and 311 complaints, as nightlife districts. At a community board's request, DSNY would add one extra day of street sweeping and litter basket service each weekend in that district. DSNY could revert to the normal schedule if cleanliness-related 311 complaints stay lower for 30 straight days.
